input.reason: Add a clear-watched capability to the store and a button in the watchlist UI.

steps.instruction: Add a method `clearWatched(): void` that removes every item whose `watched` flag is true, leaving unwatched items intact, and updates persisted state accordingly (same storage key as the rest of the store).

Add a button labelled "Clear watched" to the watchlist template that, on click, calls `store.clearWatched()`. Disable the button when `watchedCount()` is 0. On click, also update the existing `announcement` signal (e.g. announce how many watched movies were removed, or at least that they were cleared) so screen readers are informed. Only remove watched items; unwatched items must remain.
